title: Power ascension
brief: Start from shutdown. Withdraw the rods to raise the power to about a tenth of the power-high trip setpoint, then hold it there. Watch the period while the power rises, and do not trip the reactor.

goals.text: Raise the power above 1 % of the power-high setpoint
Raise the power above 10 % of the power-high setpoint
Hold the power between 5 % and 15 % of the power-high setpoint for 2 minutes

hints: Withdraw the large rods first, then use the regulating rod for fine control.
A short period means the power rises fast. The period-short trip acts below 3 s.
Fuel temperature feedback slows the rise as the fuel heats up.
